message.content: {"A0100":"A0100 most plausibly seeks to reduce direct exposure after firing by converting the head-on approach into a sustained hard right break, given its ammunition decrease at the turn’s onset and B0200’s simultaneous launch; continued descent and acceleration appear to preserve separation and maneuvering energy.","A0200":"A0200 most plausibly seeks to maintain pressure while gaining modest lateral separation after firing, using a shallower right turn that preserves strong northward closure; its ammunition decrease follows the first opposing launch, and it continues advancing rather than matching A0100’s harder break."}

answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly seeks to reduce direct exposure after firing by converting the head-on approach into a sustained hard right break, given its ammunition decrease at the turn’s onset and B0200’s simultaneous launch; continued descent and acceleration appear to preserve separation and maneuvering energy.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly seeks to maintain pressure while gaining modest lateral separation after firing, using a shallower right turn that preserves strong northward closure; its ammunition decrease follows the first opposing launch, and it continues advancing rather than matching A0100’s harder break.
